notes.title: "Bug Report" button
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/cc8c5e45e63d1eb6285e24e5bfeb5369edb83ad9.png[/img]
Dear Players,

We are aware of the vast majority of bugs and our team is actively working to address them. You can help improve the development process by reporting any issues you encounter. Simply use the "Create bug report" button in the main menu. Your feedback is crucial to us, and we appreciate your support.

[b]Important Note[/b]: Please avoid using the "Esc" key in the settings menu. We are working on a fix and will resolve this issue as soon as possible.

Thank you for your understanding and patience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/cc8c5e45e63d1eb6285e24e5bfeb5369edb83ad9.png[/img]

notes.title: Elevate Your Gaming Experience: Join the Playtest
notes.content:

[h3]Greetings, Adventurers![/h3]

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of a major update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1603870/Dads_Dice_History_of_Legends/]Dad's Dice: History of Legends[/url]! This update brings a host of new features, mechanics, and an immersive dynamic quest system that promises to elevate your gaming experience. And guess what?? We need [b]YOU[/b]!
 
[h3]Join us in playtests on [url=https://gameround.co/detail/431/info]GameRound.co[/url][/h3]

[b]What's New:[/b]

🌟 Explore fresh and exciting in-game features!
⚔️ Experience innovative mechanics enhancing gameplay.
🎨 Enjoy improved visuals for a more immersive adventure.
📜 Dive into a dynamic quest system for endless challenges.


[b]How You Can Participate:[/b]

Join the playtest on [url=https://gameround.co/detail/431/info]G.Round[/url] to be among the first to experience these exciting changes! Your feedback is invaluable and will help us shape the future of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1603870/Dads_Dice_History_of_Legends/]Dad's Dice[/url].


[b]Thank you for being part of this adventure with us! Your support and feedback mean the world. ✨[/b]


Don't forget to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1603870/Dads_Dice_History_of_Legends/]Dad's Dice: History of Legends[/url] and explore the DEMO. Stay updated with all things related to the game and be among the first to receive notifications about future updates and exciting developments.


[b]Happy gaming![/b] ːluvː

The online festival of upcoming indie games is in full swing! The nominees reveal will be on November 29th. Hope to make it to the list this year as well.

We have prepared a major update, and we will try to release it around this date.

notes.title: News from developers
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everybody![/h1]

[i][h3]I am glad to announce that the development stage of the action adventure game Dad's and Dice is confidently approaching the final stage. I would like to share with the audience what is happening behind the scenes, because D&D for us is more than just a game - it is an opportunity to create and make, challenge bold ideas and breathe to the fullest in these difficult times.[/h3][/i]

[h3][list]
[*]Lighting was brought into the dark dungeons, and where also there is light, there is life![/list][/h3]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/08154f0058c3ce4245574823d67de3650388d106.gif[/img]

[h3][list]
 [*]Over the past few weeks, the game has implemented a unique arsenal of weapons for each of the 4 heroes.[/list][/h3]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/c4554aadb745a6232e577207b50be64bdfe4d20c.gif[/img]

[h3][list]
[*]Added unique weapon skills, which will allow you to diversify the battles and get even more pleasure from the passage of each individual dungeon.[/list][/h3]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/7e201e56e0e031149cada5a3af67ef2d0e7928a9.gif[/img]

[h3][list]
 [*]Lots of FX and handpainted images for various skills have been prepared.
Decorations for all locations are ready.
More monsters![/list][/h3]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/cdbfb5f0e1f8d52a764e519e76c9eb64415d1965.gif[/img]

[h3][list]
[*]And of course the Bosses! All Bosses have moved to the polishing stage and each of them will need a unique approach.[/list][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40423861/31e01c5342770ae7fa118cb545313838a4bdd484.gif[/img]

[h3][i]We focus on interesting mechanics and quality of gameplay. At this stage, we are focusing on improving the visuals part of the game and the balance of the gameplay. And for those who like to feel the product before buying, next week, [b]Dad’s and Dice DEMO[/b]!

Thanks for attention![/i][/h3]

[i]Yours faithfully,
Mixtape Games development team.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1603870/Dads_and_Dice/
